# Dental Care Group

> > Comprehensive dental care provider across Melbourne's eastern suburbs offering general, cosmetic, emergency, and specialist dentistry with 24/7 availability.

Dental Care Group operates multiple high-end dental clinics across Melbourne's inner-east suburbs including Armadale, Malvern, Glen Iris, Prahran, South Yarra, St Kilda, and Toorak. The practice specializes in general dentistry, cosmetic treatments, emergency care, and advanced procedures like dental implants and root canal therapy, with a focus on holistic and biocompatible treatment approaches.

## Key Topics

- Emergency dentistry
- Dental implants
- Root canal treatment
- Cosmetic dentistry
- General dentistry
- Oral hygiene
- Preventive dentistry
- Dental clinics Melbourne
- Family dentistry
- Endodontics
- Gum disease treatment
- Holistic dentistry
- Same-day appointments
- Dr Zelman Lew
- Biocompatible materials

## Clinic Locations

- [Dentist Armadale](https://dentalcaregroup.com.au/dentist-armadale): High-end general & cosmetic dentistry services in Armadale with 24/7 emergency care
- [Dentist Malvern](https://dentalcaregroup.com.au/dentist-malvern): Family-friendly general, cosmetic, and emergency dentistry in Malvern with same-day appointments
- [Dentist Glen Iris](https://dentalcaregroup.com.au/dentist-glen-iris): High-end general and cosmetic dental services in Glen Iris with 24/7 emergency dentist
- [Dentist Prahran](https://dentalcaregroup.com.au/dentist-prahran): General and cosmetic dental services in Prahran with 24/7 emergency dentist availability
- [Dentist South Yarra](https://dentalcaregroup.com.au/dentist-south-yarra): Advanced general, cosmetic, and same-day emergency dental care in South Yarra
- [Dentist St Kilda](https://dentalcaregroup.com.au/dentist-st-kilda): High-end general, cosmetic dentistry and dental implants in St Kilda with 24/7 emergency care
- [Dentist Toorak](https://dentalcaregroup.com.au/dentist-toorak): State-of-the-art dental clinic in Toorak offering restorative dentistry and dental implants

## Dental Services

- [General Dentistry](https://dentalcaregroup.com.au/general-dentistry): General dentistry services including hygiene, TMJ treatment, and bruxism aids
- [Family Dentistry](https://dentalcaregroup.com.au/family-dentist): Family dental clinic offering pediatric, geriatric, and emergency care for all ages
- [Endodontics & Root Canal Treatment](https://dentalcaregroup.com.au/endodontics): Expert endodontic services including root canal treatment and pulp therapy

## Preventive Care & Wellness

- [Oral Hygiene & Prevention Programs](https://dentalcaregroup.com.au/hygiene-preventative-programs): Oral hygiene solutions and preventative care programs with patient education resources
- [Holistic Dentistry](https://dentalcaregroup.com.au/holistic-dentistry-2): Holistic dentistry approach using biocompatible materials and mercury-free treatments
